V-ENCLOSURE.evidence: The dining area is enclosed by the building, a wall, and a pergola. The fire pit area is bounded by the building, a wall, and dense planting. The standing/BBQ area is enclosed by the building and a wall.

V-FOCAL.evidence: Large canopy tree top right, fire pit left, dining table center, and pergola all compete for attention.

V-AXIS.evidence: Gravel and paved areas connect the house doors directly to the fire pit, dining table, and standing/BBO zone. The path along the left wall leads to the seating area. No paths end at blank edges.

V-RHYTHM.evidence: Large green mass in lower left with multiple overlapping circles of similar size; row of pale green circles along bottom edge; cluster of brown squares in upper left area.

V-LAYERING.evidence: The plan shows a canopy tree (large dark green circle) in the lower left, with smaller shrubs (medium green circles) and ground cover (pale green circles) layered beneath it. A separate small tree is visible in the upper right, also with ground cover. This demonstrates three distinct planting layers

V-ROOMS.evidence: Distinct zones include a gravel seating/fire pit area, a paved dining area under a pergola, a standing/BBQ paved area, and a separate herbs bed, creating a clear sequence of defined outdoor rooms.

V-OVERALL.evidence: Clear spatial structure with distinct rooms (dining, fire pit, herbs), defined edges via walls and planting masses, and organized planting zones.
